description: This PHP class implements a web service for SuiteCRM, extending the SugarWebServiceImplv3_1 class. It provides methods for user login, retrieving module layouts, searching modules, handling OAuth tokens, and managing job queue operations, facilitating SOAP-based communication between clients and the CRM system.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv4
classes.description: Implementation class for SuiteCRM's SOAP web services, extending SugarWebServiceImplv3_1 and adding specific logic for SuiteCRM in version 4.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and establishes a session, returning session data and user preferences.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Retrieves entries from a specified module based on provided IDs, including relationship data.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of beans from a module based on query parameters, supporting pagination and linked records.

methods.name: get_module_layout
methods.description: Retrieves layout metadata for specified modules, views, and types, with optional MD5 hashing.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules using a search string, returning matching records with field details.

methods.name: oauth_request_token
methods.description: Initiates an OAuth request token flow.

methods.name: oauth_access_token
methods.description: Completes the OAuth flow by obtaining an access token.

methods.name: oauth_access
methods.description: Provides OAuth access validation and session identification.

methods.name: job_queue_next
methods.description: Fetches the next job from the scheduled job queue.

methods.name: job_queue_cycle
methods.description: Runs cleanup and scheduled jobs in the job queue.

methods.name: job_queue_run
methods.description: Executes a specific job from the queue based on job ID.
